Dr BS Garg Honoured at NAMSCON 2025 Convocation
Monday, 10 November 2025
1678 Hits
Dr. B. S. Garg (Secretary, Kasturba Health Society and Ex-Director-Professor, Department of Community Medicine, MGIMS Sevagram) was conferred with a prestigious honour by the National Academy of Medical Sciences (India) during its 65th Annual Conference and Convocation (NAMSCon 2025) held from 7–9 November 2025 at PGIMER, Chandigarh.
Shri Asim Kumar Ghosh, Hon’ble Governor of Haryana,
presented the scroll of honour to Dr. Garg in recognition of his outstanding record of excellence, subject expertise of a high order, professional achievement, and leadership in the field of Community Medicine. In addition, Dr. Garg has been elected as Emeritus Professor of the National Academy of Medical Sciences (India) for a period of five years.
“MGIMS family heartily congratulates Dr. Garg for this feat. This marks yet another milestone in his distinguished career dedicated to academic excellence and community-oriented healthcare,” said Shri P. L. Tapdiya (President, Kasturba Health Society).
The conference was attended by eminent medical doctors, academicians, and institutional leaders from across the country. The convocation celebrated excellence, innovation, and leadership in medical sciences.
